output.sql: SELECT customer_id, company_name, country, segment, created_at, first_order_date, last_order_date, lifetime_orders, ROUND(lifetime_net_revenue, 2) AS lifetime_net_revenue FROM marts.dim_customers WHERE customer_id = 8;
output.explanation: This query returns all nine columns of marts.dim_customers for customer 8. I named each column instead of using SELECT *, which the rules don't allow. None of these columns is marked NOT AVAILABLE, so nothing had to be left out. Lifetime net revenue is rounded to 2 decimals.
